## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Implement `EditResourceLabels`, typed resource resolution, atomic add/remove/reset operations and expected versions. Add stores a manual inclusion; remove stores a manual exclusion even when no prior assignment exists; reset returns control to automatic evaluation through the shared scheduler. Invalidate pending requests on either manual decision. Never accept trusted origin or identity from browser params.
Files: New lib/zaq/ingestion/actions/edit_resource_labels.ex; labels.ex and ingestion/api.ex; reuse automation scheduling for explicit reset.

## Tests to add before implementation
manual add/remove, repeated remove, exclusion without a prior row, reset, no model, invalid batch rollback, stale modal, duplicate request, target mismatch, parent-document permissions, nil actor, and cross-resource isolation. No provider call for manual edits. Document assignment invariants and permission mapping.
Immediate unit/integration/property/LiveView tests apply. New feature E2E waits for human UX approval; changing existing test behavior requires explicit approval.

manual add/remove, repeated remove, exclusion without a prior row, reset, no model, invalid batch rollback, stale modal, duplicate request, target mismatch, parent-document permissions, nil actor, and cross-resource isolation. ## Mocking plan
Use real Repo, permissions, domain contexts, Action validation and dispatch wherever practical. Control only external model/embedding/conversion/provider HTTP and genuine nondeterministic boundaries. Runtime opts use Zaq.Config.get/4. No broad global mocks or sleep-based coordination. Review/approval-only steps need no mocks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
docs/services/ingestion.md and affected module docs; docs/architecture.md for approved cross-role/generation boundaries. Keep this Page's final specification aligned; progress remains in Beadwork.

## Action reuse assessment
New EditResourceLabels Action because existing provider UpdateDocument/UpdateDocumentPermissions do not manage local label assignments. Inputs typed resource, explicit edits and expected versions, trusted actor; atomic authoritative output or validation/stale/not_found/forbidden errors. Read/write inherited document permission mapping; never accept actor or provenance from request. Manual inclusion/exclusion invalidates auto request; reset reuses Automation scheduling. Jido.Exec.run/3 through Ingestion API. Verify real context/permission transactions and consumer reuse.

## Validation and prerequisites
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md. All cross-service BO calls use NodeRouter.dispatch/1 and explicit Event action. No commit/push/merge authorized. Dependencies are the serial reviewable delivery sequence; only the architecture gate should initially be ready.
